Name: Rustic Ridge by Huskyn1nja
Author: Huskyn1nja
Description:
Overlooking the valley, Grandpa was once a successful farmer. However, in his later years the farm fell into disrepair and became overgrown. As the new owner, explore the land your grandpa left you. Complete quests to repair the farm and make the land your own.

[b]Features:
[/b]• 8200+ Tillable tiles
• 15+ Quests
• Custom Farm Cave
• Freshwater Fishing
• Custom Minecart network tied into the rest of the carts
• Unlockable Farm Quarry
• Lots of daily Forage around the farm


How to trigger quests[b] [light spoiler warning]:[/b]
[spoiler]
Well: Quest unlocks after day 10
Coop 3 hearts with Marnie
Barn: 7 hearts with Marnie + Coop Complete
Quarry: Reach level 20 in the mines
Farmhouse Minecart: Complete the boiler room in the community center (or Joja equivalent)
Backwoods, Greenhouse, and Quarry Minecarts: Complete Farmhouse Minecart quest
Grandpa's Vineyard: Complete the Pantry and Craft Room bundles[/spoiler]
**New** - As of version 2.0 You will receive mail when the bundles are available and a reminder quest will be placed in your journal. These quests do not give rewards and will clear after you unlock the associated bundle.

MMAP is optional. If you have it installed, it will gave you a panorma. If it is not installed, the farm will revert to the original panorama
